title: The Munich Dengue Cohort Study: Characterization of symptomatic and asymptomatic infections with Dengue viruses in Dengue fever patients and their travel companions
summary: Diese Studie untersucht Personen mit Dengue-Fieber und ihre beschwerdefreien Reisebegleiter. Über ein Jahr werden verschiedene Krankheits-bezogene Informationen abgefragt und Labortests auf Dengue-Viren bzw.  Dengue-Antikörper durchgeführt.

interventions.name: Individuals with acute Dengue fever: At up to four visits the patient history is obtained. Blood and urine will be examined for Dengue virus and Dengue specific antibodies.
Individuals without symptoms of acute Dengue fever: At up to four visits the patient history is obtained. Blood and urine will be examined for Dengue virus and Dengue specific antibodies.

Individuals without symptoms of acute Dengue fever, who develop Dengue fever after study inclusion: At up to five visits the patient history is obtained. Blood and urine will be examined for Dengue virus and Dengue specific antibodies.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Dengue fever with direct proof
or person who has accompanied a person with dengue fever
Exclusion criteria:
no dengue fever or no travel companion with dengue fever
